MUSIC AND DANCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)

   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

8. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)

   D. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)

10. Best practice when working on Instrumental Transpositions: (1 mark)

13. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

14. Best practice when working on Western Instruments: (1 mark)

15. Primary colours are: (1 mark)

   B. Red, blue, and yellow
